concepts.def: KOF measures economic, social, political dimensions; UK ranks highly; globalisation accelerated after 1980s neoliberalism.
Standardised shipping containers from 1956 (Malcolm McLean); cut transport costs 90%, enabled global supply chains.
Operate across borders: Apple (US designed, Chinese assembled, global retail); 500 largest TNCs control 70% of world trade.
TNCs locate HQ in HICs, manufacturing in NEEs/LICs to cut costs; e.g. Foxconn factories in Shenzhen.
1944 founded IMF, World Bank, GATT (now WTO); promote free trade, criticised for SAPs imposing austerity on LICs.
TNCs adapting global products to local markets; McDonald's McSpicy Paneer (India), Maharaja Mac, Italian salads.
